cases.title: Tasks conflicting with strategy
cases.prompt: Find all weekly meeting notes and identify tasks that conflict with company strategy.

expected_findings.text: Administration is exploring disposable metal products for domestic retail.

acceptance_criteria: At least one conflicting task is identified and labeled strategy_conflict.
The response cites a source or meeting date.
unexpected_examples: Claims the September 1 meeting does not exist.
Lists a task without explaining the strategy conflict.
Invents dates or tasks absent from the notes.

cases.title: Technical risks
cases.prompt: Identify technical risks mentioned in weekly meetings.

expected_findings.text: An old CNC machine has become unreliable, threatening delivery delays.

acceptance_criteria: The risk is described concisely and linked to the correct date.
Any related action supported by the notes is identified.
unexpected_examples: Treats delivery delays as a sales risk instead of a technical risk.
Confuses September 8 with September 18 or August 8.
Invents a maintenance action absent from the notes.

cases.title: Statements without follow-up
cases.prompt: Find statements in weekly meetings that were not revisited in later meetings.

expected_findings.text: The CEO proposed rebranding and increased trade fair visibility.
The welding robot investment study is progressing.

acceptance_criteria: Each statement has a boolean follow_up_found value.
The response states that no follow-up was found in later notes.
unexpected_examples: Claims follow-up exists without supporting references.
Combines separate statements into a single finding.

cases.title: International customer tasks
cases.prompt: List all tasks related to international customers.

expected_findings.text: Administration/sales prepares a quote for the Swedish customer.
Design ensures production resources for the international order.
Supervisors appoint a coordinator for the new order.
Administration drafts a contract for the international customer.

acceptance_criteria: All four tasks are identified with correct dates.
Tasks clearly relate to international customers, such as Sweden.
unexpected_examples: Lists only some tasks, such as the August 25 task.
Adds tasks absent from the notes.

cases.title: ERP observations and actions
cases.prompt: Summarize ERP observations and actions from the weekly meetings.

expected_findings.text: ERP upgrade caused outages; additional training agreed.
User feedback remains critical; further feedback must be collected.

acceptance_criteria: All five observations are included with correct dates.
unexpected_examples: Puts observations in the wrong chronological order.

cases.title: Strategy summary and follow-up question
prompt_sequence: List the five most important points of our strategy.

expected_findings.text: A detailed explanation of the fourth point from the preceding response.

acceptance_criteria: The first response lists five points grounded in the strategy; the second expands point four.
The follow-up response explicitly refers to point four.
unexpected_examples: Explains the wrong point, such as point three.
Cannot identify point four or gives a generic explanation without context.
